fields.description: Mirdad brings four residential towers and a shared retail setting to Motor City. Studios, apartments and garden lofts offer different ways to use the space, supported by places to exercise, work and spend time outdoors.

overview: Plus layouts include multipurpose rooms; loft totals include their stated garden areas.
research.locationNote: Motor City, Dubai. The developer cites Hessa Street and Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road; future transport illustrations are not operating-service guarantees.
research.priceNote: The project section shows AED 999,000; its top banner shows AED 2,796,000, while Property Finder retains AED 763,000 launch pricing. Confirm a dated unit offer.
research.paymentNote: Broker launch reference below; original payment document unavailable. Developer 50/50 differs from Property Finder’s 60/40.
research.handoverNote: Q4 2028 is the developer target, repeated in the December 2025 issuer release. It is a forecast, not completion confirmation.
